verdict.rationale: Fly.io documents encrypted, vaulted secrets for apps, plus org-wide credential management for Sprites: connect a service once for the whole org, scope access by name, label or endpoint, and rotate once to propagate. However, nothing shows team or member access controls such as roles or permissions, or central management of plain environment variables. missing for 10: team/member role-based access management, centralized environment-variable management across apps, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can manage team-level access, secrets, and environment variables centrally

citations.quote: Secrets allow sensitive values, such as credentials, to be passed securely to your Fly App. The secret is encrypted and stored in a vault.
Connect a service once for your whole org, and every Sprite can reach it. Nobody pastes a token.
Grant access on purpose: by Sprite name, by label, or down to a single endpoint
Rotate once and every Sprite has the new credential.
